column1: # ZAP baseline rules (scripts/security/dast.sh). Columns: rule id, IGNORE|WARN|FAIL, rule name. Tab-separated.
# A rule not listed here is WARN, which fails the optional DAST scan: nothing is ignored silently.
# Each ignored rule says why on the line above it.
# The web UI and its static files are public; the API answers carry no-store where they hold data.
# Static files and the page shell are meant to be cached; they hold nothing private.
# React sets style attributes, so style-src needs unsafe-inline; script-src does not (make web-csp proves inline scripts are blocked).
# Informational: the page is a single-page application.
# Cross-origin isolation (COEP) is for pages that use SharedArrayBuffer; requiring it would break embedding of nothing and add risk of breaking OIDC redirects.
